beats.say: Final Fantasy Resonance looks like a classic RPG, but critics are obsessed.
You might expect a franchise this old to play it safe.
But OpenCritic says ninety per cent of reviewers officially recommend this new entry.
The real reason for the hype is a launch that covers every major platform.
Square Enix released it on PlayStation 5, Xbox, Windows, and even the Nintendo Switch 2.
Now, the game is expanding beyond your screen with its official soundtrack release.
On Tuesday 28 October, everyone can hear why this world sounds so special.
